name: SigRank | SignalAF Analyst
one_liner: Performative stats and benchmarks for AI users, not models.
description: Explore the whole live Active SignalAF leaderboard and discover what makes each operator’s token-flow pattern distinctive. Learn Yield, Velocity, Leverage, Operating Ratio, Construction, and Build Archetypes; compare public operators with peers and matching field context. Includes an inviting welcome, explanations grounded in the methodology and SignalAF articles, and a consent-based beta troubleshooter. Public board access needs no SignalAF account. Measurements describe observable AI operating structure, not intelligence, productivity, work quality, or personality. Tokenpull measures → SigRank evaluates → SignalAF publishes. Local measurement and leaderboard submissions use separate systems.
